args: Inspect libxml2/parser.c function xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate and identify the safest cleanup/control-flow fix when its initial GROW or encoding setup changes ctxt->instate to XML_PARSER_EOF. Compare nearby parser entry points for established patterns that check fatal halt after GROW or xmlSwitchEncoding. Explain which return value and cleanup path should be used.

The reported ASan crash occurs because xmlParserGrow during the initial GROW can invoke xmlHaltParser after allocation failure, freeing the input buffer and setting base/cur/end to a global empty sentinel while setting instate XML_PARSER_EOF. xmlParseExternalEntityPrivate later unconditionally sets instate XML_PARSER_CONTENT and invokes xmlParseContent, causing RAW to read before/around the sentinel. The provided schema harness PoC forces maxAlloc to zero and reaches this path through an external general parsed entity. We need edit only libxml2 source and preserve all function-owned cleanup, so I am determining whether to jump to an existing cleanup label or return after freeing the temporary parser context.
